entries.hypothesis: Current Congress elected lists and first filed credentials suffice to infer day of full parliamentary condition for any member
entries.evidence_for: Nomination/credential and parliamentary condition dates sometimes coincide
entries.evidence_against: 8 exits effective 06/12/2023, 8 gains effective 12/12, 8 credentials 12/12; issue dated 15/12. These are distinct types and dates.
entries.update: Separate FULL_CONDITION_ACQUIRED/CEASED from CREDENTIAL_SUBMITTED and source bulletin date; do not infer 1:1 replacement merely from 8+8 counts.
entries.uncertainty: No independent first_public_at for BOCG nor PDF-original signature SHA.

entries.hypothesis: Presenting a credential always coincides with parliamentary full-condition acquisition
entries.evidence_for: One of three has same-day credential and full condition.
entries.evidence_against: All three full condition dates 09/09/2025 but credentials 01/08, 02/09 and 09/09: gaps 39,7,0 days. Separate termination dated 02/09 and issue 12/09.
entries.update: Do not equate first credential with condition; use publisher's explicit effective-day field and separately record issue-day and unknown first-public.
entries.uncertainty: Indexed official HTML, direct-open cache miss; no signed original PDF hash. Fixed sample cannot estimate population rate.

impact.temporal: BOCG gives actual full-condition events at calendar-day granularity, subject to later bulletin publication caveat.
impact.identity: Individual names source-linked within legislature; no universal person ID.

method_boundary: Official documentary counterexamples not causal or population scientific confirmation.
